name: sky-rich-v1
description: THE CEILING ARM for balloon reward magnitude. Every sweepable balloon reward doubled from 4 to 8 (the magenta Harvest-any balloon has no amount, so this arm can only enrich three of the four - the same limitation sky-dull-v1 carries). Paired with sky-dull-v1 at 1, it brackets the whole usable range of the module's generosity. THE QUESTION IT ANSWERS IS NOT 'are balloons good' BUT 'can balloon rewards move the VEGETABLE suit at all' - the Vegetable seat takes only 0.39 of the table's balloon moves against an even share of 0.34, so the module is very nearly a communal trough and an enrichment may simply be a gift to the table. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved.
